components.label: Description
components.quote: ENGERIX-B [Hepatitis B Vaccine (Recombinant)] is a sterile, injectable suspension of noninfectious HBsAg for intramuscular use.

components.label: Description
components.quote: It contains purified surface antigen of the virus obtained by culturing genetically engineered Saccharomyces cerevisiae cells, which carry the surface antigen gene of the hepatitis B virus.

components.label: Description
components.quote: The HBsAg expressed in the cells is purified by several physicochemical steps and formulated as a suspension of the antigen adsorbed on aluminum hydroxide.

allergens.quote: The procedures used to manufacture ENGERIX-B result in a product that contains no more than 5% yeast protein.
The tip cap and rubber plunger stopper of the prefilled syringe are not made with natural rubber latex.
Each 1 mL adult dose contains 20 mcg of HBsAg adsorbed on 0.5 mg aluminum as aluminum hydroxide.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote: Severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) after a previous dose of any hepatitis B-containing vaccine, or to any component of ENGERIX-B, including yeast, is a contraindication to administration of ENGERIX-B [see Description (11)].

warnings.label: Latex
warnings.quote: The vial stoppers are not made with natural rubber latex.

dismissed.egg: 命中詞皆為 when 字尾或 lichen（皮膚病 lichen planus）子字串，非蛋成分提及；ENGERIX-B 為酵母菌（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）表現系統，仿單未提蛋
dismissed.peg_polysorbate: 命中詞皆為 between 字尾子字串，非 polysorbate/PEG 提及；仿單全文未提 polysorbate 80 或 PEG
